items.title: Arose gabw nwngni sigangao
items.customLyrics:
Arose gabw nwngni sigangao -2
Gaswi jwngni nangou khou
Nwng gaswi mithijwbgou
“O . . . swrgw Bifa jwngni”-2 -2
(A)
Anldainai subungni Bifa nwngw
Menglinai subungni laokhar nwngw -2
Jiu arw jiu, Rajani raja, Gwthar fwrni gwthar -2
(B)
Gwthar khwmsalini gudi nwngw
Gwmanai subungni lama nwngw -2
Bifa-Bisa, Gwthar jiu jwng
Saselo Isor Nwng-2

items.title: Aya vo jagat mein
items.customLyrics:
Aaya vo jagat mein, paapiyon ko karne paritran
Laya vo jeevan deep sansar ko karne ujjala -2
Marg vahi, satya vahi, jeevan bhi vahi hai -2
(A)
Vo vahi Masi hai jo aane wala
Vo vahi Masi hai jo bachane wala -2
Swarg uska, dharti bhi, sabka vahi hai rakha wala
(B)
Dukh uthaya Prabhu ne, taaki hamen mukti mile
Balidan hua Ishu ne, taise hamen jeevan mile-2
Mukti vahi hai, jeevan bhi, sabka vahi hai rakha wala
